title: Meltano Failures by Job
app: Meltano ELT run logs via UF and the Meltano Cloud API via HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=meltano:run exit_code!=0
| stats count as failures, latest(_time) as last_failure by job_name
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Counts Meltano failures grouped by job so operators immediately see which specific jobs are broken rather than a single global failure number.
value: Object-level failure attribution turns a vague 'Meltano is failing' alert into an actionable list of exactly what to fix first.
implementation: Ingest Meltano failure events; schedule every 15 minutes and alert on failures for business-critical jobs.
visualization: Table of job by failure count and last failure time.
grandmaExplanation: We tell you exactly which parts of Meltano are failing, not just that something is wrong, so the right thing gets fixed first.
